description: Land Title Settlement Department   -  Calling for claims to land parcels in Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District  and other land  settlements
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and land ownership claims across multiple districts, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
